description: Defines the TrialComparisonCertVerifier class used for comparing certificate verification results between two CertVerifyProcs, including callback mechanisms and configuration management.

classes.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier
classes.description: A CertVerifier that compares results from two different CertVerifyProcs and reports differences via a callback.

methods.name: TrialComparisonCertVerifier
methods.description: Constructor initializing the verifier with factory, fetcher, parameters, and report callback.

methods.name: trial_allowed
methods.description: Checks if trial verification is allowed.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification, returning primary result and optionally initiating trial verification.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for verifier events.

methods.name: UpdateVerifyProcData
methods.description: Updates verification process data with fetcher and parameters.

methods.name: OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the underlying cert verifier.
